review_evidence: README identifies the source as a full formalization of the main results of Pflueger, arXiv:2206.14227, plus additional results on 321-avoiding permutations and Demazure factorizations.
The 12 primary Lean modules cover ASP permutations, inversion sets, slipfaces, submodularity, reduced products, reduction theorems, transposition formulas, tableaux, and supporting lemmas.
A declaration scan finds 316 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations in the hydrated source, confirming a dense independent mathematical development rather than project infrastructure.
summary: Retain demazure, a Lean formalization of the extended Demazure product on almost-sign-preserving integer permutations and related combinatorics.
